scope: bounded landmark supervised experiment (one class tower + one green roof-light keypoint); shadow only; no PPO; no control; no board/navigation/Gate acceptance

stop_rule.rule: patience counted from the first evaluation AFTER warmup_epochs; warmup epochs never stop the run and never set the best-so-far baseline
stop_rule.reason: ultralytics' internal EarlyStopping compares against the all-time best epoch, so a lucky warmup epoch stopped a run at epoch 24 on 2026-11-04 (protocol violation, run discarded)
stop_rule.internal_ultralytics_patience: made inert (set to epochs) and replaced by the callback above

selection_rule: highest validation joint narrow-primary (scripts/evaluate_landmark_yolo.py metrics.json), tie-break lower validation FP, then lower seed; thresholds frozen separately on the same validation split

rules: present + reference unavailable -> bbox + bbox-centre placeholder v=0
ambiguous/undecidable/GT_UNOBSERVABLE -> frame excluded entirely, never a background sample

environment.note: install ML dependencies only in the isolated venv; never modify the Isaac venv (E:\isaac\env_isaaclab)
environment.known_pins: torch==2.7.0+cu128, ultralytics==8.2.0, onnx==1.22.0, onnxruntime, onnxsim==0.8.1, numpy==1.26.4 (ultralytics 8.2.0 uses np.trapz, removed in numpy 2.4), opencv-python==4.10.0.84, pandas==2.2.3, ml-dtypes==0.5.4

artifact_policy.weights_and_logs: ignored outputs/ only; never commit weights or full logs
artifact_policy.evidence_json: one bounded_evidence_seed<N>.json per seed under the evidence root
artifact_policy.overwrite_policy: existing evidence is never overwritten unless --overwrite is explicit; --skip-existing reuses it

license.status: AGPL-3.0 obligations unresolved; user authorised INTERNAL bounded research/evaluation on 2026-11-04; external distribution is a separate decision; not a legal conclusion; no automatic model switch

dev_split.note: dev v4: train 160 frames / val 163 frames (HN 53/53); no final or holdout read for training or selection
